decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay with a mix of creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure on the opponent using low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, backed up by spells like Titan's Strength and Reckless Rage to enhance their effectiveness. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for extra mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful attacks and burn spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, while also utilizing disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the tempo of the game. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly take down opponents. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of removal spells and land destruction cards to disrupt opponents' strategies and gain the upper hand in the match. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption to secure victories.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly and aggressively to the opponent. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of early creature aggression and direct damage spells, using cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary to get ahead on board presence. The inclusion of Atarka's Command and Monstrous Rage provides additional reach and damage to help finish off the opponent. The deck thrives on putting pressure on the opponent early and maintaining that pressure throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Lotus Field and combo off by chaining Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages to untap lands and draw cards. The deck also utilizes cards like Thespian's Stage, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Bala Ged Recovery to further manipulate the board state and maximize mana efficiency. Emergent Ultimatum serves as a powerful finisher, while cards like Strict Proctor and Archdruid's Charm provide disruption and protection. The deck aims to set up a dominant board state and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and abilities.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and card advantage, using spells like Lightning Axe, Consider, and Fiery Impulse to both remove threats and trigger the Phoenix's ability. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Proft's Eidetic Memory also allows for card draw and recursion, while cards like Picklock Prankster and Hall of Storm Giants provide additional value and threats on the board.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cast spells and creatures to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal fast damage to the opponent. Utilizing cards like Consider and Opt to dig for more spells and fuel the graveyard, while also including removal spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to clear the way for attacks. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher, while Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder help to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient spellcasting.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays using powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester, supported by disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. It aims to control the board and apply pressure early on, utilizing burn spells like Go for the Throat and Kolaghan's Command for removal. The deck also includes graveyard interaction with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. With cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, the deck aims to deal damage as fast as possible. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. The deck also includes utility cards like Fatal Push and Claim/Fame to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to be fast, efficient, and relentless in applying pressure to the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Resplendent Angel, Righteous Valkyrie, and Skyclave Apparition. By utilizing mana accelerants like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to cast spells like Collected Company and Kayla's Reconstruction early to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures. The inclusion of cards like Bishop of Wings and Giada, Font of Hope provide additional synergy and value to the deck, allowing for potentially explosive turns and aggressive combat strategies.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck prioritizes aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger to deal damage quickly. With a low mana curve and a focus on direct damage, this deck aims to end games swiftly before opponents can stabilize. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional consistency and a versatile mana source. Overall, this deck seeks to apply constant pressure and finish off opponents before they have a chance to build up a defense.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells that deal quick damage. The focus is on utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, along with burn spells such as Fatal Push and Heartfire Hero, to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also includes cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Titan's Strength to pump up creatures for extra damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a wide board presence with efficient creatures like Resplendent Angel, Youthful Valkyrie, and Skyclave Apparition. The deck also includes cards like Righteous Valkyrie and Bishop of Wings to benefit from gaining life, while Collected Company helps to refill the board with more threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency, allowing the deck to consistently apply pressure and overwhelm opponents with fast and aggressive plays.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly build a strong board presence with aggro creatures, while also benefitting from lifegain synergies to outvalue opponents. Utilizing various angels and creatures with lifegain abilities, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and resilient strategy. The deck includes cards that provide additional creatures or removal, as well as lands that support both the creature base and mana base. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to generate incremental advantages through lifegain and aggressive creature plays in order to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce their life total to zero. Utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with efficient burn spells like Reckless Rage and Monstrous Rage, you aim to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck, further enhancing its aggressive strategy. By maintaining pressure on your opponent and utilizing your resources effectively, you aim to secure victory in the early game.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, utilizing the power of Rakdos colors to push through damage quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional versatility and consistency in the deck. Cards like Ancestral Anger, Titan's Strength, and Monstrous Rage help pump up creatures for additional damage, while cards like Dreadhorde Arcanist and Slickshot Show-Off provide utility and card advantage. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply pressure early and maintain momentum to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Spirit creatures to apply early pressure and disrupt opponents with counter spells. It includes a mix of flying creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller to control the board. The deck also features disruptive cards such as Skyclave Apparition and Portable Hole to handle threats efficiently. The mana base is designed to support a smooth curve of spells, allowing for consistency in applying pressure while keeping up with countermagic. Wedding Announcement provides additional utility and resilience to the deck's strategy.
